steps.title: A card coloured by a CSS variable
steps.titleZh: 用 CSS 变量上色的卡片
steps.text: The card's background is `var(--accent)`, and the page's stylesheet sets `--accent: #547a91` on `:root`: steel blue. `--accent` is a native CSS custom property. Unlike a Less variable, it stays in the CSS that the browser keeps, so it can still change after the page has loaded.
steps.textZh: 卡片的背景是 `var(--accent)`，页面的样式表在 `:root` 上设置了 `--accent: #547a91`，也就是钢蓝色。`--accent` 是原生 CSS 的自定义属性（custom property）。和 Less 变量不同，它会留在浏览器拿到的 CSS 里，所以页面加载之后仍然可以改。

steps.title: Change the theme while the page runs
steps.text: **Change theme** runs one line: `document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent', '#98542d')`. That inline style on `<html>` wins over the `:root` rule in the stylesheet, and every rule that reads `var(--accent)` picks up the new value at once. The card turns rust brown, with no new build.
steps.textZh: **切换主题**只运行一行：`document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent', '#98542d')`。`<html>` 上的这条内联样式压过了样式表里的 `:root` 规则，所有读取 `var(--accent)` 的规则都立刻用上新值。卡片变成铁锈般的棕色，不需要重新构建。

steps.title: The stylesheet still says steel blue
steps.titleZh: 样式表里仍然是钢蓝色
steps.text: The click did not touch the `<style>` element: its `:root` rule still sets `#547a91`. The new value lives in the `style` attribute of `<html>`. Remove it, and the card falls back to the stylesheet's colour.
steps.textZh: 刚才的点击没有改动 `<style>` 元素：它的 `:root` 规则仍然是 `#547a91`。新值写在 `<html>` 的 `style` 属性里。把它去掉，卡片就会回到样式表里的颜色。

steps.title: Less variables are gone after the build
steps.titleZh: 构建之后，Less 变量就不见了
steps.text: A Less variable exists only while the file is compiled. This button fetches `mix/mix.less` and the CSS that the build wrote from it, `dist/mix/mix.css`, and shows what `border-radius` is set to in each: `@var_radius` in the source, only the values `5px` and `20px` in the CSS. If `dist/` is missing, run `npm run build -w @latte/less` first.
steps.textZh: Less 变量只在编译时存在。这个按钮取来 `mix/mix.less` 和构建从它生成的 `dist/mix/mix.css`，显示两者各自把 `border-radius` 设成了什么：源文件里是 `@var_radius`，CSS 里只剩下 `5px` 和 `20px` 这两个值。如果还没有 `dist/`，先运行 `npm run build -w @latte/less`。

action.run: (async () => { for (const file of ['mix/mix.less', 'dist/mix/mix.css']) { const response = await fetch(file); if (!response.ok) { console.log(file + ': not found. Run npm run build -w @latte/less, then try again.'); continue; } const text = await response.text(); console.log(file + ': border-radius: ' + [...text.matchAll(/^\s*border-radius:\s*([^;]+);/gm)].map((match) => match[1]).join(' and ')); } })().catch((error) => console.log('Could not load the files:', error))

steps.actionLabelZh: 对比 mix.less 和它编译出的 CSS
